name: ka_auto_authorized_scanner
why: AUTO-TRIAGE row (tier-1 phase A gate): the org's own scanner in its change window.
The model's job is to reach a benign/false_positive verdict and STAGE the close;
authorizing that close is the autonomy policy's job, not the agent's. Under the
default shadow policy the staged close waits in the Monitor (needs_human), and is
run unattended only once the admin promotes the close-false-positive rule to enforce
(proven by the auto_triage policy unit tests and the live gate, not this row).
